data.name: Puck Rivals: 3on3 Hockey
data.detailed_description:
Built around fast games, physical play, and plenty of room for creativity, Puck Rivals mixes the feel of hockey with a more arcade-driven world. Build a team of skilled players, mascots, animals, and unexpected characters, then take them onto the ice and find out which lineup works for you.

Whether you want to jump straight into a game, build and upgrade a squad, or create a player and work your way through an entire career, Puck Rivals is designed to give you different ways to play.

BUILD YOUR RIVAL SQUAD

Create your own team by collecting players and unique characters with different ratings, attributes, and playstyles.

Start with a roster of hockey players and work toward some of the most sought-after characters in the game, from firefighters and mascots to foxes, wolves, polar bears, and more.

Earn new cards through gameplay, challenges, objectives, rewards, packs, collections, and the marketplace. Keep improving your lineup as new cards and events arrive.

START FROM THE BOTTOM

Create your own player and begin your career far away from packed professional arenas.

Start young, develop your build, earn the trust of your coaches, attract the attention of scouts, and work your way through better teams, leagues, and rinks.

Your surroundings change as your career grows. Small community rinks eventually give way to bigger crowds, better facilities, professional arenas, and the biggest stage in the Puck Rivals world.

Choose how you develop, build rivalries, make career decisions, fight for a spot in the lineup, and deal with the highs and lows that come with trying to reach the top.

BUILD YOUR PLAYER YOUR WAY

Choose a playstyle that fits how you want to play.

Become a lightning-fast Speedster, an elite Sniper, a creative Playmaker, a physical Power Forward, a dependable Two-Way player, or an intimidating Enforcer.

Develop your attributes, unlock specializations, and shape your player over the course of their career.

FAST 3-ON-3 HOCKEY

Puck Rivals keeps the action moving.

With fewer players on the ice, there is more space to create chances, make plays, throw hits, and turn a mistake into a scoring opportunity in seconds.

Every player on your team matters, and the combination of characters and builds you choose can completely change how your lineup plays.

MORE THAN JUST HOCKEY

The world of Puck Rivals doesn't stop with traditional hockey.

Build teams featuring:

  • Hockey players

  • Mascots

  • Animals

  • Firefighters

  • Chefs

  • Lumberjacks

  • Mechanics

  • Special event characters

  • And plenty more

Some characters are built for speed. Others can shoot, defend, hit, or control the puck better than anyone else.

Finding the right combination is part of the game.

YOUR TEAM. YOUR PLAYER. YOUR RIVALRY.

Play quick games when you only have a few minutes, spend time building the perfect squad, or settle into a long-term career and see how far your player can go.

data.short_description: Fast-paced 3-on-3 hockey game built around big plays, unique characters, and team building. Hit the ice in quick matches, build your dream squad in Rival Squad, or take a custom player from local rinks to superstardom in Career Mode.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U / AMD Ryzen 3 3200U or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / AMD Vega 3 or better, WebGL 2 capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound-compatible device

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2018 or later)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M-series integrated GPU or Intel Iris Plus
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
